propositions: The duration probe currently infers large timing gaps before completion verdict as residuals, but lacks direct instrumentation to measure gated-close phase intervals precisely.

Direct timing instrumentation must constrain itself to time.monotonic_ns integer arithmetic and cheap dictionary assignments on the existing call path, adding no I/O, subprocess, network, tracker event, tracing, lock, or model call.

Ten direct millisecond timing fields must be recorded and merged into the existing COMPLETION_VERDICT.metrics payload alongside existing sidecar writes and consumption metrics, including git-history-read, alias-index-build, and ticket-reference-resolution subsections of referencing_commits.
The added bookkeeping cost must measurably remain below 50 microseconds per close execution, verified by standard-library CPU microbenchmark with GC disabled.
Legacy records lacking direct timing fields must be labeled legacy_uninstrumented in the duration probe, without assigning causal operation names to their unexplained residuals.

Existing callers must remain unchanged when optional timing dictionaries are not supplied, and synthetic tests must cover timing propagation, counts, metric preservation, argument compatibility, and probe reporting.
